data.name: Herbalism
data.description: An herbalist's studies allow him a unique method of creating alchemical discoveries. He can attempt Profession (herbalist) checks in place of Craft (alchemy) checks for all purposes, and he gains a competence bonus equal to half his alchemist level on Profession (herbalist) checks to create alchemical items and to forage for and process herbs (see page 152). [NOT IMPLEMENTED] An herbalist uses his Wisdom score instead of his Intelligence score for all alchemist class abilities. This alters alchemy and the alchemist's key ability score.
